note: Write your answer in your own words, then say it out loud in under 90 seconds.

items.text: Tell me about yourself (education, what you built, why this role)
Why software development? (career switchers: why now)
Your strengths and one real weakness with what you do about it
A time you were stuck on a hard bug and how you got unstuck
Explain any gap year or low marks honestly and briefly
Salary expectations: know the fresher range for the role (check current listings)
Two good questions to ask the interviewer
2-minute pitch: problem, users, what it does
Explain the architecture diagram from memory
One technical decision and the alternative you rejected
The hardest bug in the project and how you fixed it
What you'd change with two more weeks
Demo video recorded and linked in the README
What happens when you type a URL and press Enter
REST: resources, methods, status codes
Sessions vs JWT, and where you store the token
Database indexes: what they speed up and what they cost
Caching: where and when to cache
Scaling a simple app: vertical vs horizontal, load balancer
Rate limiting and why APIs need it
One-page resume with links to both capstones
GitHub profile: pinned repos with READMEs and screenshots
LinkedIn headline and projects updated
150+ DSA problems solved across all patterns
Timed aptitude test score of 70% or more
First mock interview done (friend, mentor or recorded)
Second mock interview done, with fixes from the first
